title: Getting Started
subtitle: Set up @angular-translation-service/core in your Angular v19+ project in 3 minutes.
step2_desc: Create JSON files in your project's public/ directory. Angular serves files from public/ at the root URL, so public/i18n/en/common.json is available at /i18n/en/common.json. The loader uses the pattern basePath/lang/namespace.json:
step4_desc: Use select() to get a namespace signal. The @if guard handles the loading state — while the namespace loads, the recursive proxy prevents template crashes.
step5_desc: For simpler cases, use TranslatePipe instead of select():
